hints.title: Compute the delta first
hints.content: Calculate how far the target is from the current power: `double delta = targetPower - currentPower;`. Then check if the magnitude of that delta exceeds MAX_RAMP.

hints.title: The if/else clamp
hints.content: If `delta > MAX_RAMP`, add MAX_RAMP to currentPower. If `delta < -MAX_RAMP`, subtract MAX_RAMP from currentPower. Otherwise, the target is close enough — just set `currentPower = targetPower` directly.

hints.title: Why ramp?
hints.content: Sudden full-power commands can tip the robot, skip wheels, and stress the drivetrain. A ramp (also called a slew rate limiter) limits how fast power changes each loop iteration, giving smoother acceleration and deceleration.
